name: Barbarian audit: Crusher resets Crush's cooldown from a native DBC-generated proc, no code needed (#1257)
contract: Crusher rank 2 (807875, passive) has one effect: APPLY_AURA SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (42) triggering 807911 with EffectBasePoints 0. Spell.dbc gives 807875 ProcFlags 4 (PROC_FLAG_DONE_MELEE_AUTO_ATTACK) and ProcChance 20, matching the tooltip 'Melee auto attacks now have a 20% chance to reset the cooldown of Crush'. No spell_proc/spell_linked_spell/spell_proc_event row exists for 807875 anywhere in the repository. That looked like the same gap as Essence Harvester (#1182, see bloodmage-essence-harvester-fang-reset.json): SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs only builds a spell_proc row from a spell's own DBC ProcFlags when that field is nonzero (SpellMgr.cpp ~2253, 'Skip if no proc flags in DBC'); Essence Harvester's DBC ProcFlags is 0, so it needed an explicit row. Crusher's DBC ProcFlags is 4 (nonzero), so the same loader's default-proc generator (SpellMgr.cpp 2194-2328, isTriggerAura[SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL] = true) builds one automatically from the DBC ProcFlags/ProcChance -- no SQL or C++ change needed. The triggered spell 807911 has one effect, SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_RESET_COOLDOWN (195, EffectMiscValue 500915 = Crush, EffectMiscValueB 0), an existing generic handler (Spell::EffectAscensionResetCooldown) that resets the target spell's cooldown/category through the normal ResetAscensionCooldown path used by every other Ascension reset-on-proc talent in this module. Crush (500915) has RecoveryTime/CategoryRecoveryTime 25000ms, so putting it on cooldown and then landing enough 1900ms-speed auto attacks (Worn Shortsword, item 25) to exceed the 20% chance's false-failure probability (40 swings: 0.8^40 is about 0.013%) proves the whole native chain -- proc generation, trigger dispatch and the reset effect -- without any fix.

steps.label: Crusher's DBC-generated proc resets Crush's cooldown without any code or SQL change
the proc was actually recorded against Crusher's aura
